summary: RESPONSIVE FIT audit only (frontend). Measured document.documentElement.scrollWidth vs window.innerWidth for 13 routes at mobile (390), tablet (768), desktop (1440) = 39 combinations. ZERO horizontal overflow on every combination. Also verified: mega-menu at 1024 & 1280 sits on a single row (header height 82px, mobileToggle hidden), hamburger appears at <1024 and opens the mobile panel (31 links), all PageHero h1 titles render within their containers without clipping at every width, LeadForm & 2-col sections don't overflow at mobile/tablet, ManagementSlider (range input) never clips at 390/768/1440, and Footer has no overflow at either mobile or desktop.
responsive_overflow_matrix: 13 routes x 3 viewports = 39 checks. ALL 39 report scrollWidth - innerWidth = 0. Routes checked: /, /properties, /areas, /areas/prototype-chelsea-residence*, /sell, /lettings, /landlords, /property-management, /investment, /mortgages, /insights, /about, /contact. (*See note below.)
notes_for_main_agent: The review request lists route '/areas/prototype-chelsea-residence' but that slug belongs to a PROPERTY, not an area. src/lib/areas.ts only defines area slugs: 'chelsea','kensington','fulham'; 'prototype-chelsea-residence' is a slug in src/lib/properties.ts. So visiting /areas/prototype-chelsea-residence returns the Next.js 404 page (h1='404') on all 3 viewports (which itself has 0 overflow, so the audit still passes).

For completeness I retested the correct routes at all 3 widths: /areas/chelsea (h1='Chelsea', 342/672/1344px, no clip, 0 overflow) and /properties/prototype-chelsea-residence (h1='Chelsea Residence', 350/672/896px, no clip, 0 overflow). Both are perfectly responsive.

detailed_findings.hero_h1_clipping: None. All PageHero titles and /areas/[slug] h1 fit within container at 390/768/1440 (scrollWidth === clientWidth).

lifecycle_tiles.note: distinct top-Y counts confirm progressive column count (single-col mobile -> multi-col desktop); no overflow

Functional and lint-clean but very hard to maintain/diff. Same pattern observed in src/lib/areas.ts and src/lib/properties.ts. Consider reformatting for readability.
Only 3 area slugs are seeded (chelsea/kensington/fulham); the review contract references a 'prototype-chelsea-residence' area slug that doesn't exist. Align data/spec.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (39/39 overflow checks + nav + hero + forms + slider + footer)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Responsive audit is clean across all 13 routes x 3 viewports. Only oddity is the reviewer-supplied route /areas/prototype-chelsea-residence which does not exist in data (it's a property slug). If E1 adds it as an area or a redirect, re-run the same responsive audit script on that route.
rca_of_the_issue: No responsive fit issue found. The 404 on /areas/prototype-chelsea-residence is not a responsive bug but a slug mismatch between review contract and src/lib/areas.ts (which only defines chelsea/kensington/fulham). Root cause: prototype-chelsea-residence is defined in src/lib/properties.ts as a property, not in areas.
